mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY FACSTOP.FSTP_CODE) AS ROW_NUM, FACILITY.FAC_NAME, FACSTOP.FSTP_PLAN, FACSTOP.FSTP_TU, FACSTOP.FSTP_STBY, FACSTOP.FSTP_01, FACSTOP.FSTP_02, FACSTOP.FSTP_03, FACSTOP.FSTP_04, FACSTOP.FSTP_05, FACSTOP.FSTP_06, FACSTOP.FSTP_07, FACSTOP.FSTP_08, FACSTOP.FSTP_09, FACSTOP.FSTP_10, FSTP_BIGO, FSTP_CODE, LEFT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, FACSTOP.FSTP_DATE, 120), 10) AS FSTP_DATE FROM FACSTOP INNER JOIN FACILITY ON FACSTOP.FAC_CODE = FACILITY.FAC_CODE WHERE FACSTOP.FSTP_DATE between #{sdate} and #{edate} ORDER BY FACSTOP.FSTP_DATE, FACILITY.FAC_NAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FACSTOP ( FSTP_CODE, FAC_CODE, FSTP_DATE, FSTP_PLAN, FSTP_TU, FSTP_STBY, FSTP_SIL, FSTP_MAN, FSTP_MHR, FSTP_01, FSTP_02, FSTP_03, FSTP_04, FSTP_05, FSTP_06, FSTP_07, FSTP_08, FSTP_09, FSTP_10, FSTP_BIGO ) VALUES ( (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(FSTP_CODE), 0) + 1 FROM FACSTOP), #{fac_code}, #{fstp_date}, #{fstp_plan}, #{fstp_tu}, #{fstp_stby}, #{fstp_sil}, #{fstp_man}, #{fstp_mhr} , #{fstp_01}, #{fstp_02}, #{fstp_03}, #{fstp_04}, #{fstp_05}, #{fstp_06}, #{fstp_07}, #{fstp_08}, #{fstp_09}, #{fstp_10}, #{fstp_bigo} )
mapper.select: SET LOCK_TIMEOUT 10000; SELECT FACSTOP.FSTP_CODE, FACSTOP.FAC_CODE, LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR, CONVERT(datetime, FACSTOP.FSTP_DATE, 120), 120), 10) AS FSTP_DATE, FACSTOP.FSTP_PLAN, FACSTOP.FSTP_TU, FACSTOP.FSTP_STBY, FACSTOP.FSTP_SIL, FACSTOP.FSTP_MAN, FACSTOP.FSTP_MHR, FACSTOP.FSTP_01, FACSTOP.FSTP_02, FACSTOP.FSTP_03, FACSTOP.FSTP_04, FACSTOP.FSTP_05, FACSTOP.FSTP_06, FACSTOP.FSTP_07, FACSTOP.FSTP_08, FACSTOP.FSTP_09, FACSTOP.FSTP_10, FACSTOP.FSTP_BIGO, FACILITY.FAC_NAME FROM FACSTOP WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN FACILITY WITH(NOLOCK) ON FACSTOP.FAC_CODE = FACILITY.FAC_CODE where FSTP_CODE = #{fstp_code}
mapper.update: UPDATE FACSTOP SET FAC_CODE = #{fac_code}, FSTP_DATE = #{fstp_date}, FSTP_PLAN = #{fstp_plan}, FSTP_TU = #{fstp_tu}, FSTP_STBY = #{fstp_stby}, FSTP_SIL = #{fstp_sil}, FSTP_MAN = #{fstp_man}, FSTP_MHR = #{fstp_mhr}, FSTP_01 = #{fstp_01}, FSTP_02 = #{fstp_02}, FSTP_03 = #{fstp_03}, FSTP_04 = #{fstp_04}, FSTP_05 = #{fstp_05}, FSTP_06 = #{fstp_06}, FSTP_07 = #{fstp_07}, FSTP_08 = #{fstp_08}, FSTP_09 = #{fstp_09}, FSTP_10 = #{fstp_10}, FSTP_BIGO = #{fstp_bigo} WHERE FSTP_CODE = #{fstp_code}
mapper.select: SET LOCK_TIMEOUT 10000; WITH valid AS ( SELECT FAC_CODE, ILBO_STRT, ILBO_END, ILBO_JUNG FROM WORKILBO WHERE FAC_CODE IN (1,2,3,4,18,16,17) AND ILBO_STRT >= #{sdate} AND ILBO_STRT < DATEADD(DAY, 1, #{edate}) AND ILBO_END IS NOT NULL AND ILBO_END <> '1900-01-01 00:00' AND ILBO_END > ILBO_STRT AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, ILBO_STRT, ILBO_END) <= 1440 ), work_agg AS ( SELECT FAC_CODE, COUNT(*) AS work_cnt, SUM(ISNULL(ILBO_JUNG, 0)) AS work_jung, SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, ILBO_STRT, ILBO_END)) AS work_time FROM valid GROUP BY FAC_CODE ), grp AS ( SELECT *, MAX(ILBO_END) OVER (PARTITION BY FAC_CODE ORDER BY ILBO_STRT, ILBO_END ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_max_end FROM valid ), isl AS ( SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_max_end IS NULL OR ILBO_STRT > prev_max_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new FROM grp ), island_id AS ( SELECT *, SUM(is_new) OVER (PARTITION BY FAC_CODE ORDER BY ILBO_STRT, ILBO_END ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS grp_id FROM isl ), segs AS ( SELECT FAC_CODE, grp_id, MIN(ILBO_STRT) AS seg_start, MAX(ILBO_END) AS seg_end FROM island_id GROUP BY FAC_CODE, grp_id ), run_agg AS ( SELECT FAC_CODE, SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, seg_start, seg_end)) AS run_time FROM segs GROUP BY FAC_CODE ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.sort_order) AS ROW_NUM, t.fac_code, t.fac_name, t.gubn, t.total_time, t.run_time, t.idle_registered, CASE WHEN t.total_time - t.run_time < 0 THEN 0 ELSE t.total_time - t.run_time END AS idle_natural, (CASE WHEN t.total_time - t.run_time < 0 THEN 0 ELSE t.total_time - t.run_time END) + t.idle_registered AS idle_total, ROUND(t.run_time * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_time, 0), 2) AS RunRate, ROUND(((CASE WHEN t.total_time - t.run_time < 0 THEN 0 ELSE t.total_time - t.run_time END) + t.idle_registered) * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_time, 0), 2) AS idle_rate, t.work_cnt, t.work_jung, t.work_time FROM ( SELECT FAC.FAC_CODE AS fac_code, FAC.FAC_NAME AS fac_name, CASE WHEN FAC.FAC_CODE IN (1,2,3,4,18) THEN '열처리' ELSE '템퍼링' END AS gubn, CASE FAC.FAC_CODE WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 4 THEN 4 WHEN 18 THEN 5 WHEN 16 THEN 6 WHEN 17 THEN 7 END AS sort_order, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, #{sdate}, DATEADD(DAY, 1, #{edate})) AS total_time, ISNULL(RA.run_time, 0) AS run_time, ISNULL(FS.idle_registered, 0) AS idle_registered, ISNULL(WA.work_cnt, 0) AS work_cnt, ISNULL(WA.work_jung, 0) AS work_jung, ISNULL(WA.work_time, 0) AS work_time FROM FACILITY FAC LEFT JOIN run_agg RA ON RA.FAC_CODE = FAC.FAC_CODE LEFT JOIN work_agg WA ON WA.FAC_CODE = FAC.FAC_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FAC_CODE, SUM(ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT, FSTP_10), 0)) AS idle_registered FROM FACSTOP WHERE FAC_CODE IN (1,2,3,4,18,16,17) AND FSTP_DATE >= #{sdate} AND FSTP_DATE < DATEADD(DAY, 1, #{edate}) GROUP BY FAC_CODE ) FS ON FS.FAC_CODE = FAC.FAC_CODE WHERE FAC.FAC_CODE IN (1,2,3,4,18,16,17) ) t ORDER BY t.sort_order
